title: Terror Hotel
physical_identity: Infinite 1930s-style hotel complex with 1920s furniture; mahogany/gold wallpaper, wood/marble/carpet floors, self-cleaning surfaces, random smooth jazz. Three accessible areas: Main Hall, Beverly Room, Boiler Room.
scale_topology: Infinite indoor hotel; three linked areas; elevators lead to floors 1-382 but 1-12 only move within the level.
anomalies: random jazz from vintage sound system
doors with patternless room numbers, some open/close randomly
elevator floors 13+ mean death or disappearance
Beverly Room unfinishable Mahjong game repels
lighting_sound: Antique candle holders, some electric lamps that buzz like Level 0; quiet jazz, party chatter behind walls, boiler machinery and dripping.

entities.name: Deathmoths
entities.behavior: Large population/central hive; swarm halls from dark rooms; Females stay in nests

entities.name: Hounds, Woodlins, Skin-Stealers, Watchers, Nguithr'xurh, Growlers, Deathrats
entities.behavior: Listed as known to appear; no behaviour given

entities.name: Entity 26 (Samantha)
entities.behavior: Wanders Main Hall; approach with high-quality meat

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Deathmoths (swarms), plus listed Hounds, Woodlins, Skin-Stealers, Watchers, Nguithr'xurh, Growlers, Deathrats; Entity 26, Entity 89, Wrangler as reports
hazards: extreme Boiler Room heat toward Level 6
items_communities: M.E.G. Outpost Housekeeping (guides through Boiler Room)
Homely Hotel (Main Hall hotel service; bases also in Level 11, 230)
The Originals (~31 members from 1300-1940, in a Beverly Room)
The Lost Hall Society (remnants in Level 5.3)

signature_mechanic: Infinite hotel with floor-numbered elevators: floors 1-12 relocate within the level, 13+ means death/disappearance; Beverly Room hub with many doors leading mostly to Main Hall, sometimes Boiler Room.
verticality: None real: elevators for floors 1-12 stay on the same floor; above 12 unknown.
conflicts_notes: Level 98 metal-door exit listed twice. Level 126, 92, 4.2 have no link slug in the snapshot link list. Page ends with a joke aside to Entity 18's office.
